title: Coefficient-four log^11 loglog^9 construction with entropy-paid overlap

claims.statement: Joint CircuitBreaker theorem under rules.md: the following declaration defines ONE fixed eligible total uniform NP family in the pinned full B2 model at actual input length n. Its full guarantee and its declared projection both hold unconditionally, for all sufficiently large integer lengths with the quantifiers specified by the theorem kinds. Both score source claims assert this ENTIRE declaration, not separate lemmas. For g(n)=c*n^p*(log2 n)^q*(log2 log2 n)^r with the exact parameters in guarantee, liminf over all integer n of C_B2(f_n)/g(n) >= 1. Equivalently, for every epsilon>0 there is N_epsilon such that C_B2(f_n)>=(1-epsilon)*g(n) for every integer n>=N_epsilon. Declaration: {"convention":"uniform-np-full-b2-actual-length-all-lengths-v1","family":"One fixed total scale-header language in family.py, including PolyPlan/PolyEngine. At large actual N, L=ceil(log2 N) input bits encode S-1. Every scale1<=S<=2^L is evaluated; rejected large plans give zero and the small lengths N<128 output zero. With z=ceil(log2 L), exact parameters are k=P2(S^13 L^11 z^9),h=e=P2(S L^2 z^2),ell=P2(S^3 L^4 z^3),eprime=P2(S^5 L^6 z^5),d=P2(S^9 L^6 z^5),Y=P2(S^11 L^9 z^7). Independence order h is separate from binary index alphabet2 with d0 rounds. Initial dimension12 is fixed and only the initial map uses A1; four internal maps use the direct B2.2 block half-output extractor with deterministic tower fields, exact weak designs and seed O(E^2/z), while short E1 uses the B2.3 multi-bit polynomial hash with cost O(ell+eprime+log N)=O(eprime); all five internal maps have zero data. The robust map has m=floor(delta*r), w=ceil(log2 r), b=floor(floor(sqrt(S))*w^2/(30*10^24)), u=2b+2w+10. B5 uses field degree1000w, 100w-bit polynomial-hash blocks, and a deterministic conditional-expectation weak-design construction in a universe ceil(5a^2/2)+a for a=2000w. The complete table-hybrid proof and polynomial(r) construction cost are supplied, with r=O(log N). Only the hash modulus is design data; no design A1 matrix or weak-design table is supplied. Every header and supplied input construction datum is an actual input bit, not advice or witness. Good S0 is used only for a charged hardness restriction; eligibility holds on every header and field string. B2.2 emits blocks of E+ceil(log2 M)+10 bits with ceil(M/block) rows; B5 uses ceil((m-c)/(100w)) rows and truncates only its last block. The initial seed cap is10000L; only the initial A1 package has matrix data, with145 field elements. Four internal weak designs use t=floor(log2 L),rho=2^t<=L,T=ceil(2a^2/t)+a and source threshold4rho*M; their table budget isrho*M<=K/4. B5 retains its separate3/2 design.","guarantee":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"polynomial_log","log_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"},"loglog_exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"0"}},"projection":{"coefficient":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"4"},"exponent":{"denominator":"1","numerator":"1"},"kind":"finite"},"theorem":"This fixed total language is in P and NP with empty witnesses on every input. There exist absolute B>0,N0 such that for every actual integer N>=N0, unconditionally in pinned full B2, C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-B*(log2 N)^11*(log2(log2 N))^9. For the SAME family and every fixed epsilon>0, eventually C_B2(F_N)>=4*N-(log2 N)^11*(log2(log2 N))^(9+epsilon), hence also4*N-(log2 N)^(11+epsilon) and4*N-N^epsilon. One fixed ordinary header S0 gives hardness. Exact loss is4*P(N,S0)+8*k(N,S0), including the ENTIRE header and all data; P<=20000L eventually, hence P=O(L)=o(k). The supplied finite4n-8d theorem covers all16 B2 tables, constants and sharing. The robust moment proof needs O(r^2*u) independence and log-error. Layout loses only a factor2^O_S0(log r), preserving actual bad-coordinate accounting. No numerical B, efficient search for S0 or unpaid weak-design construction is assumed.","version":"circuitbreaker-expression-v1"}

experiments.purpose: Bounded exact checks of the actual merged evaluator, scalar extraction plans, fixed-seed linearity, multi-bit hash collision distributions, weak-design conditional expectations and block truncation, field towers/PV maps, header and zero-data offsets, refreshed index mocks, robust-function arithmetic and full-B2 local sharing patterns. Obsolete optional gate-lemma and extractor-tree fixtures are omitted. These checks do not establish the universal theorem or instantiate the eventual enormous family.
